_meta.usage: SKILL.md generation mode MUST read this file and require generated drafts to approximate avg_words_per_example_sentence and tense_distribution_approx.

paragraph_rhythm is APPROXIMATE (inferred from blank-line grouping).
Baselines reflect the source book's excerpted examples, not a universal rule.
